recreation_prompt_markdown:
<!-- Creative Remix v5 recreation prompt. -->

Recreate `The Shape on Haddonfield Lane` as a mobile-first portrait browser game. Preserve the source loop: timed depth-based stalkers spawn far away, approach the player, one tap on a projected hitbox removes one closest valid threat and increments score, holding RUN or shaking adds retreat pressure, close contact removes 20 nerve/health, zero nerve shows game over and restart. Rebuild presentation as Halloween slasher survival: a survivor on a porch-cam/flashlight view faces a silent masked figure in black coveralls on an autumn suburban street. Use a pale mask, knife glint, falling leaves, porch lights, dark houses, orange/blood/ivory palette, Creepster title typography, Rajdhani readable HUD, compact feedback media, and large touch-friendly controls. Do not add new progression, inventory, aiming, or win mechanics; make the existing survival pressure feel like slow unstoppable slasher pursuit.
blueprint_markdown:
<!-- Creative Remix v5 blueprint filled for The Shape on Haddonfield Lane. -->

# Source Game Truth
- genre: mobile-first first-person canvas survival shooter / evasion pressure game
- objective: survive as long as possible by tapping approaching humanoid threats before they reach the player, while using run/shake input to push pursuit distance back
- input model: touch or mouse on the canvas fires at one point; RUN button press/hold and device motion add retreat energy; start and restart use normal click/tap buttons
- core loop: spawn depth-based stalkers at timed intervals, advance them toward the camera, tap hitboxes to remove one closest valid target and increment score, retreat slows or reverses approach, close contact costs health, zero health ends the run
- fail/friction state: each close contact removes 20 health/nerve; game over hides HUD and controls and shows final score with restart

# Protected Mechanics
- Preserve perspective depth spawning from far z distance into close-contact threshold.
- Preserve tap-to-hit point-in-rectangle targeting, closest target priority, one threat removed per successful shot, and score +1 per removed threat.
- Preserve hold RUN / device-motion retreat semantics, including run energy decay, retreat speed, and cap on pushed-back distance.
- Preserve health/nerve loss on contact, game-over transition at zero, and restart reset semantics.
- Preserve mobile portrait input actionability: canvas consumes gameplay touches only, UI buttons keep native tap paths.

# Safe Theming Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title, instructions, color palette, procedural enemy silhouette, weapon/flashlight styling, background scene ownership, particles/leaves, audio URLs from approved dark catalog entries, GIF feedback, fonts, overlay copy, score label, health label, failure wording, and progression naming are presentation-safe and transformed.

identity.title: The Shape on Haddonfield Lane
identity.prompt: Halloween slasher survival with a masked menace stalking suburban autumn streets in mobile portrait.
identity.identity: A first-person porch-cam survival game where the player drives back an approaching silent slasher by tapping him and running to preserve nerve.
identity.player_role: Halloween night survivor trying to keep distance from The Shape until the run ends.
identity.core_loop: Start the night, watch stalkers advance in depth, tap a masked stalker to score one escape, hold RUN or shake to push pursuit back, lose nerve on contact, restart after failure.
